subject: Architecture
title: Masdar City: A Zero-Carbon Experiment
description: A micro-lesson that makes Masdar City: A Zero-Carbon Experiment usable.

hook.text: Abu Dhabi tried to build a zero-carbon city in the desert. Fifteen years later, the results are mixed.

buildup.text: Masdar City planned solar power, driverless pods, narrow streets for shade, and zero waste — in the desert.

discovery.text: The city uses 40% less energy and 60% less water than a conventional Abu Dhabi development.

twist.text: The original zero-carbon goal was quietly dropped. Full sustainability in a desert proved too ambitious.

climax.text: Despite setbacks, Masdar taught the world what works at scale — and what doesn't — in green city design.

punchline.text: They aimed for perfection and landed on progress. That still matters.

quiz.question: How much less water does Masdar City use compared to a standard development?
